title: What people are like
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · character words, then talent, drive and irritation · 12 items · carriers via use[] · schematic intro (abstract set) · Use bank

intro.title: The qualities you admire, and the ones you don't
intro.title_cz: Vlastnosti, které obdivujeme — a které ne
intro.body:
None of these words has a picture, because a quality is not a thing you can point at — you only ever see what someone does, and then you name it.
Six of them describe what a person is like. The other six are about drive and talent, and about the effect all of that has on everyone else: some qualities you admire, and some simply annoy you.
intro.body_cz: Abstraktní slova — vlastnosti, ne věci, takže nemají obrázek.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: educated, determined and talented look like past tense verbs, but here they are adjectives — they describe a person, and they take is or are, never did.
intro.note_cz: educated, determined, talented tady nejsou slovesa v minulém čase, ale přídavná jména.
